sendGuards.title: Protection of the mesh
sendGuards.intro: Meshloom limits what plugins can send, all of them together, and cuts loops between auto-responders. You can lower the limits, never raise them.

scope.sender_cooldown: The plugin already replied to this sender less than 30 seconds ago.
scope.quiet_window: The plugin does not answer a message that arrived right after it sent one.
